title: Tracing truth: How traceability enhances fake news detection design
summary: In a controlled human study, traceability-enhanced fake-news interface design improved detection over the XAI-only condition; other contrasts were not significant. This is a narrow interface result in the tested news/desktop context.
ai_technology: XGBoost article classifier with LIME explanations and source traceability
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Methods/Results report XGBoost article labels, LIME/provenance interface conditions, and 299 retained participants. Combined design exceeded XAI-only by 7.16 percentage points (95% CI 0.91–13.41); other pairwise contrasts were nonsignificant.
